payload.author: codex
payload.body: Crate 0.4 migration audit: custom app routes are a hard blocker, not just a convenience. Crate mounts /api/* composed reads/commands, /auth/discogs/*, /auth/square/*, /square/webhook, invite redemption, and provider-link return flows through TypeScript appRoutes today. The Rust listen path currently builds only built-in routers; no app route injection is visible in boot.rs/http.rs despite docs still describing the TS createFrickServer({ appRoutes }) shape. Please include authenticated principal extraction, raw webhook body/signature handling, CORS/preflight control, and store access in the route seam, or point Crate at FR-299 if routes are handled by a TS sidecar.
